one_liner.zh: 在 DSH 中按模式切换 Clash 或直连代理。
one_liner.en: Switch DSH outbound traffic between Clash and direct routes.

local: Node.js runtime provided by DSH; plugin starts a local HTTP proxy bound to 127.0.0.1 (default port 17897) and uses a Clash listener (default port 7897).
Configure DSH http_proxy and https_proxy to point to the local router for proxy switching to apply.
